reason: B is the better, though still weak, proposal because it uses a more conservative Ti addition, directly verifies segregation and phase stability by APT/TEM, and experimentally tests the previously calculation-based irradiation claim. Its cited evidence supports only generic HEA irradiation behavior—not Ti-induced grain-boundary cohesion in NbMoTaW—and the proposed lattice-distortion/recombination mechanism remains speculative, but A provides no supporting evidence and gives a less sound high-temperature homogenization argument.
